title: ABLKM: A Hybrid BB84 QKD and Geometric Indexing Framework for Secure Local Key Registries
description: Reproducibility artifact accompanying the ABLKM research paper. The artifact provides a software BB84 simulation, the Angular-Bucket Lattice Key Mapping (ABLKM) geometric indexing mechanism, HMAC-SHA256 registry identifiers, HKDF-SHA256 key derivation, AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, benchmark scripts and results, and an interactive browser-based visualization.
